title: Unique Umami Polish Paccheri Pasta
description: A fermented, springy, quick-fix Polish dish featuring paccheri pasta and a mirepoix base, this vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the richness of sauerkraut and the earthiness of mushrooms for a deep umami flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the paccheri pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions, carrots, and celery until they are softened.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and continue to cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer while the pasta cooks.
Stir in the sauerkraut and cook until heated through.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the sauce and sauerkraut.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
